adaptations: Console media and resource execution is exposed as cancellable per-task library operations.
The chapter parser accepts an already fetched and verified page and preserves upstream question DTOs and option identifiers.
Task cards are refreshed before execution; the specific alternate chapter read remains available.
Elapsed time bounds media positions; final confirmation uses the Console waiting window.
The platform transport classifies verification and the worker persists write checkpoints and server readback.
Console log output is collected per account; initialization receives the configured Core logging level.
